==Objectives==
Find 3 Flasks of Port for Sailor Valia at the Kul Tiran Embassy in Stormwind Harbor.
* [[Flask of Port]] (3)

==Description==
All this time stationed around and yet we hardly have any ale to tide over the boredom.

Say mainlander, you must have freedom to walk the streets of the city without a job looming over your head, how about a favor?

We are currently busy with tasks during the day, but we could use some loosening up during the night, if you catch my drift.

Head into the city, it should be ripe with ale, find me 3 Flasks of Port, that should do quite well.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*2100 XP
*+75 [[reputation]] with [[Kul Tiras (faction)|Kul Tiras]]

==Progress==
So, you find the port...?

Like the ale.

==Completion==
Ahh, this is the good stuff.

Well, from one sailor to, whatever you are mainlander, thanks a bunch.

==Notes==
Flasks of Port can be bought from [[Elly Langston]] at the [[Pig and Whistle Tavern]] while speaking with [[Sailor Hylreth]] for {{questlong|Alliance|14|Controlling Sailors}}.
